camel_example: aliyun nas DescribeSnapshots --region cn-hangzhou --Status all --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --FileSystemType extreme --SnapshotIds 's-extreme-67pxwk9aevrkr0000,s-extreme-snapsho0000,s-extreme-6tmsbas6ljhwh0000' --FileSystemId 'extreme-22f0000' --SnapshotType all --SnapshotName FinanceJoshua
description_en: Queries information about one or more snapshots of a specified file system
description_zh: 查询指定文件系统一个或多个快照的信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-snapshots --file-system-type extreme --file-system-id extreme-22f0000 --snapshot-ids s-extreme-67pxwk9aevrkr0000,s-extreme-snapsho0000,s-extreme-6tmsbas6ljhwh0000 --snapshot-name FinanceJoshua --snapshot-type all --status all --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSnapshots

parameters.help_en:
The file system type.

Valid values: extreme (Extreme NAS file system)
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统类型。

取值：extreme（极速型NAS）
parameters.name: file_system_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot IDs.

You can specify multiple snapshot IDs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 100 IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh:
快照标识编码。

可以由多个快照ID组成，多个ID用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多支持100个ID
parameters.name: snapshot_ids

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot type.

Valid values:
auto: automatic snapshot
user: manually created snapshot
all (default): all snapshot types
parameters.help_zh:
快照类型。

取值：
auto：自动快照
user：手动创建的快照
all（默认值）：所有快照类型
parameters.name: snapshot_type

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot status.

Valid values:

progressing: The snapshot is being created.
accomplished: The snapshot is created.
failed: The snapshot failed to be created.
all (default): all snapshot statuses
parameters.help_zh:
快照状态。

取值：

progressing：正在创建的快照
accomplished：创建成功的快照
failed：创建失败的快照
all（默认）：所有快照状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings for the number of rows per page in paging.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the snapshot list.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
快照列表的页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the snapshot list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

CompletedTime.description_en:
The completion time.

The time follows the ISO 8601 (https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) standard in UTC. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`.

This field is valid only when the snapshot status is accomplished. While the snapshot is being created, the value of this field is the same as CreateTime
CompletedTime.description_zh:
完成时间。

按照ISO 8601 (https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html)标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`。

这个字段仅在快照状态完成时有效，在快照创建过程中，这个字段的值和CreateTime一致

CreateTime.description_en:
The creation time.

The time follows the ISO 8601 (https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) standard in UTC. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建时间。

按照ISO 8601 (https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html)标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`

EncryptType.description_en:
The encryption type.

Valid values:
0: not encrypted
1: encrypted
EncryptType.description_zh:
加密类型。

包括：
0：不加密
1：加密

Progress.description_en: The progress of snapshot creation. The value is expressed as a percentage
Progress.description_zh: 创建快照的进度。以百分比表示

RemainTime.description_en:
The remaining time required to create the snapshot.

Unit: seconds
RemainTime.description_zh:
正在创建的快照任务剩余完成时间。

单位：秒

RetentionDays.description_en:
The number of days that automatic snapshots are retained.

Unit: days.

Valid values:

-1: Automatic snapshots are permanently retained. When the number of snapshots reaches the quota limit, the earliest snapshots are automatically deleted.
1 to 65536: Automatic snapshots are retained for the specified number of days. Expired snapshots are subject to automatic release
RetentionDays.description_zh:
自动快照保留天数。

单位：天。

包括：

-1：永久保存，当快照数量达到额度上限后被自动删除。
1~65536：指定保存天数，保留时间到期后快照会被自动释放

SnapshotName.description_en:
The snapshot name.

This parameter is returned only if a snapshot name was specified when the snapshot was created
SnapshotName.description_zh:
快照名称。

创建快照时指定了快照名称，则返回快照名称。创建快照时未指定快照名称，则不返回此参数

SnapshotType.description_en:
The snapshot creation type.
Valid values:
auto: automatic creation of snapshots
user: manually created snapshot
SnapshotType.description_zh:
快照创建类型。
枚举值：
auto: 自动创建快照
user: 手动创建快照

SourceFileSystemId.description_en:
The ID of the source file system.

This field is retained even if the source file system of the snapshot has been deleted
SourceFileSystemId.description_zh:
源文件系统ID。

如果快照的源文件系统已经被删除，该字段仍旧保留

SourceFileSystemSize.description_en:
The capacity of the source file system.

Unit: GiB
SourceFileSystemSize.description_zh:
源文件系统容量。

单位：GiB

SourceFileSystemVersion.description_en: The version of the source file system

Status.description_en:
The snapshot status.

Valid values:

progressing: The snapshot is being created.
accomplished: The snapshot is created.
failed: The snapshot failed to be created
Status.description_zh:
快照状态。

包括：

progressing：正在创建的快照
accomplished：创建成功的快照
failed：创建失败的快照
